repeat.limits: Three training seeds, one geometry, fixed data split/order. Means and sample standard deviations; no significance or flight-hardware claim. Positive loss delta means feasible/fair is worse.

codec.quality: CPU codec tests across all five archived clients; no quantized learning-quality claim

contacts.geometry: Synthetic SGP4 mean elements, WGS72; altitude seeds mean motion only

geometry.method: Shared python-sgp4 propagator and archived mean elements; independent Astropy TEME/ITRS/topocentric transforms and grid/bisection event search versus Skyfield events.
geometry.earth_orientation: Offline bundled Astropy IERS and Skyfield builtin timescale; no EOP downloads or refraction.
limitations: Numerical cross-check of synthetic geometry, not validation against measured spacecraft passes.
SGP4 is shared by both methods; this does not independently validate the force model.
Two coarse grids plus bisection do not prove absence of sub-five-second grazing passes.
Radio link budgets, weather, antenna steering, energy and spacecraft compute remain uncalibrated.

recovery.scope: CPU durable-receiver extension and existing link-engine checks. Not integrated into archived GPU training or a socket/radio transport. Eligibility is transactional; model aggregation is a separate operation.
limitations: SHA256 detects corruption against trusted manifests; it does not authenticate senders.
Process-death tests do not emulate filesystem/hardware power loss.
No optimizer or in-flight GPU-step recovery; mission-run automatic resume remains unsupported.
Attempted bytes include payload retries only, not RF framing or retransmission timing.

scope: Archived GPU studies plus independent CPU engineering additions. No new training or benchmark selection.
